candidates.label: Neurofibroma of the left buccal space

response.rationale: The biopsy showing wide fibroblast proliferation and the well-bordered, mobile, painless nature favor a benign fibrous tumor such as fibroma over nodular fasciitis (which is typically painful and rapid) or desmoid (which is infiltrative). The absence of neural features on biopsy argues against neurofibroma.
